text: Could you make me some music, because that’s the part I’m trying to sort out at the moment? I’ve been overthinking this a little, which is probably why I’m taking more words than necessary to explain a fairly simple request. What I’m looking for is something upbeat, and it’s for a reel, so that’s really the idea behind asking for music in the first place. I’m excited about putting it together, even if I’m making the asking part sound more complicated than it is.
